name: Kiel
author: pierreggt
description: Map of Kiel, Germany, from the city center to the surrounding Schleswig-Holstein towns (Preetz, Schwentinental, Altenholz, Plön, and others). Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022), with real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchoring Kiel and its neighboring municipalities.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online), OSM, Overture Maps
